metadata.title: LLM-in-Finance-Economics network: foundation technology → reusable function → workflow/asset task
metadata.scope: LLM-in-Finance-Economics functionality; not a pedagogy or Study Planner taxonomy.

groups.L2: data_knowledge; analytics; decision; action; simulation_learning; controls_governance
groups.L3: workflow/domain tasks with asset_class and workflow_stage fields

edge_semantics.requires: functional prerequisite; use only when necessary
edge_semantics.risk_propagates: failure/risk path; not a causal efficacy claim

metadata.evidence_policy: E012 OMI homepage is context-only. Domain finance/economics edges are hypothesis unless a specific source is attached. Generic LLM/agent foundations use cited papers/docs from project research.

two_hop_task_reachability.caveat: Reachability reflects graph density and edge typing, not empirical validity.

scorecard_denominators.note: These are distinct audit scorecards; do not compare their bucket counts as one denominator.

two_hop_task_reachability.caveat: Reachability reflects graph density and edge typing, not empirical validity.

scorecard_denominators.note: These are distinct audit scorecards; do not compare their bucket counts as one denominator.

metadata.metric_catalog: metrics.csv includes domain/function/evidence coverage, PIT leakage, extraction/citation, forecast calibration/utility, Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown/turnover/exposure, VaR/ES/stress/hedge, valuation, portfolio/attribution, execution/TCA/market-making, compliance/KYC/AML/surveillance/reporting, simulation, training/scaling/inference, and governance/privacy/incident metrics.

gaps.missing_or_weak: No known orphan functions; optional/precedes edges separate controls.

gaps.existing_nodes: Specific evidence on generic agent/LLM foundations
gaps.missing_or_weak: OMI homepage is context only; finance mappings remain hypotheses.
gaps.recommendation: Attach domain papers/datasets before asserting efficacy
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Many finance edges intentionally remain hypothesis.

gaps.existing_nodes: Document QA, forecast, valuation, risk, portfolio, execution, market making, central-bank, compliance, research, simulation and governance tasks
gaps.missing_or_weak: Add asset-specific variants as data sources become available.
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Coverage is structural, not evidence of performance.

gaps.existing_nodes: Scaling, distributed, FlashAttention, quantization, MoE, speculative, long context and vLLM nodes
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Foundation presence is not production validation.

gaps.missing_or_weak: Attach official regulatory rulebooks and labeled cases.
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Hypothesis until domain sources and labels are attached.

gaps.existing_nodes: Causal macro function and CB-COMMS task
gaps.missing_or_weak: Attach econometric/central-bank publications and identification protocol.

gaps.requirement: Risk backtests, utility and cost metrics
gaps.missing_or_weak: Require held-out walk-forward and confidence intervals.
gaps.recommendation: Do not treat generic task success as economic utility

audit_summary.method: Finance-aware proxy: 20% raw degree + 25% cross-layer degree + 35% downstream task reach + 10% risk degree + 10% feedback degree; proxy is not economic importance.

evidence.claim: Agentic systems combine a model/controller, state, tools, runtime, permissions and evaluation in an observe-decide-act loop.
evidence.note: Synthesis from the project agentic-AI research note; operationalization is a design choice.

evidence.claim: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces and actions for tool-using agents.
evidence.note: Use as a research anchor; benchmark outcomes are task/setup specific.

evidence.claim: Tool-use research supports learning or evaluating API/tool selection with structured calls.
evidence.note: Toolformer is evidence for tool-use training ideas, not production readiness.

evidence.claim: ToolLLM studies tool-use planning over large API collections.
evidence.note: Model and benchmark claims are paper-specific.

evidence.claim: MCP Python SDK documents a protocol for interoperable tools/resources/prompts.
evidence.note: Protocol support does not establish security or production quality by itself.

evidence.claim: vLLM provides an OpenAI-compatible serving path and documents batching, KV-cache and parallelism features.
evidence.note: Pin version, model revision, hardware and exact benchmark settings.

evidence.claim: HELM frames evaluation as holistic across accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, efficiency and toxicity.
evidence.note: HELM releases and task definitions change; record version and prompt settings.

evidence.claim: lm-evaluation-harness is an open few-shot evaluation runner.
evidence.note: Pin commit, tasks, decoding and contamination checks.

evidence.claim: AgentBench, WebArena, tau-bench, SWE-bench, OSWorld and BFCL provide agent/tool-use evaluation anchors.
evidence.note: Use the individual benchmark links in the research note and retain benchmark-specific limits.

evidence.claim: OWASP, AgentDojo and guardrail/approval guidance identify prompt injection, tool misuse, data leakage and excessive agency risks.
evidence.note: Threat taxonomy is an input to threat modeling, not proof of mitigation.

evidence.claim: RAG pipelines require ingestion/chunking, indexing, retrieval/reranking, context budgeting and citation/grounding checks.
evidence.note: Exact retrieval and groundedness metrics depend on corpus and task.

evidence.claim: Oxford-Man Institute is the project context for quantitative-finance research themes.
evidence.note: Homepage is a context anchor; specific OMI project/task mappings remain hypotheses until a project page or paper is attached.

evidence.claim: Attention Is All You Need introduces the Transformer attention architecture.
evidence.note: Architecture anchor; does not support claims about current model quality.

evidence.claim: Chinchilla studies compute-optimal parameter/token allocation.
evidence.note: The paper's ratios are study-specific, not universal constants.

evidence.claim: InstructGPT documents SFT, preference reward modeling and PPO alignment stages.
evidence.note: Results depend on prompts and raters.

evidence.claim: DPO provides a direct preference-optimization objective without the standard separate reward-model/online-sampling recipe.
evidence.note: Not a guarantee that DPO dominates RLHF.

evidence.claim: GRPO and DeepSeek-R1 reports are anchors for reasoning/RL study tasks.
evidence.note: Scores and emergent-behavior claims are setting-specific and self-reported.

evidence.claim: DeepSeek family papers/reports document MoE, long context, multimodal and serving-relevant model variants.
evidence.note: Use model-specific papers/model cards for any production decision.

evidence.claim: FlashAttention uses IO-aware tiling for exact attention; speedups depend on sequence length, GPU and kernel implementation.
evidence.note: Use as an implementation anchor, not a universal throughput guarantee.

evidence.claim: Speculative decoding drafts tokens with a smaller model and verifies with a target model while preserving the sampling distribution in the paper setup.
evidence.note: Reported speedups are setup-specific.

evidence.claim: Switch Transformers route tokens to sparse experts to scale total parameters while limiting per-token compute.
evidence.note: Routing balance, communication and stability remain deployment constraints.

evidence.claim: RoPE encodes relative position with rotary phases; long-context extrapolation depends on model and scaling method.
evidence.note: Long-context capability is checkpoint and protocol specific.

Periods satisfying allocation, turnover, liquidity and risk constraints.
